segments.text: Welcome to the Central Library orientation.
Effective this semester, our working hours are 8 in the morning until 10 at night on working days,
and 9 in the morning until 6 in the evening on weekends.
Undergraduate students may check out up to four books at a time for 14 days.
Overdue fines are 2 rupees per day, capped at 200 rupees per title.
The Digital Resource Center is located on the second floor.
